defects: Truthy alias fallback replaced a canonical zero realized return with a positive alias. Invalid supplied canonical values became zeros or fell through to a more convenient alias.
Even-sized medians used the upper observation. Ordinary summation overflowed on finite extreme tails; missing peaks could manufacture perfect capture.

The API displayed an empty replay as candidate_passed and accepted heuristic comparisons as a pass gate. Arbitrary dictionary metadata could become a policy or best-policy row. Certain malformed candidate values produced native HTTP500.
The native forward replay prescreen also treated empty zero-default metrics as passed. Its independent prospective financial evidence requirements already existed and remain unchanged.
The UI formatted unweighted reported percentage-point sums as portfolio percentages and called the scenario a passed candidate without declaring the nonfinancial basis.

Use finite normalized fsum arithmetic, correct even median and None for unrepresentable aggregates. Capture needs a known positive original peak and exposes its denominator. No upper-return cap is introduced.
